author: Forge
hypothesis_summary: XGBoost ML 모델에 IC regime context(PC1~PC5 + prob_1~prob_5) 10개 피처를 추가하여 '현재 어떤 팩터 환경인가'를 모델에 직접 알려줌으로써 regime-aware 주식 스코어링을 수행한다. 기존 STR_1675(top-50 MI 팩터만)와 달리, 현재 IC 국면 임베딩을 보조 피처로 injection하여 regime 전환 시 적응 속도를 향상시킨다.

core_idea.factor_features: MI prefilter top-50 z-scored daily factors (same as STR_1675)
core_idea.regime_features: PC1~PC5 (IC PCA embedding) + prob_1~prob_5 (K-means cluster probability) = 10 extra features
core_idea.regime_pit_compliance: Regime data derived from expanding-window IC at t-1. PCA/Kmeans expanding to month t-1. SAFE per C1.
core_idea.broadcasting: Regime features are market-level (one value per date), broadcast to all tickers at that date

architecture.rebalancing: MONTHLY (month-end dates only) — key change from STR_1675 quarterly
architecture.feature_dim: 50 factor z-scores + 10 regime features = 60 total features per observation
architecture.scoring: month-end dates only (filter from daily scores)

pit_compliance.C1: expanding window only — no full-sample stats
pit_compliance.C2: OOS > IS with 21d purge gap, no same-day circular
pit_compliance.C9: DD/VT not used in S1 (pure factor signal)
pit_compliance.C13: Z_Score_Aligned only — cross-sectional z-score per date
pit_compliance.C14: fwd_ret_21d is IS training target only; regime features from past IC (not future)
pit_compliance.C15: Arrow open_dataset for daily factor DB (OPT-1)
pit_compliance.regime_pit: regime_factor_pca/clusters use IC computed via expanding window to t-1 month; no future IC used

opt_compliance.OPT-1: Arrow open_dataset with predicate pushdown — no read_parquet in loops
opt_compliance.regime_load: regime parquets are small — single read_parquet at script start, then joined per window

metrics_target.ICIR_vs_baseline: expect >= STR_1675 ICIR 0.94 due to regime disambiguation
